dedupe_keys.name: deutsche bundesbank payment and securities settlement statistics

description: Germany's official statistics on payments and securities settlement. The Bundesbank page offers the tables of its statistical series on payment and securities settlement as a complete PDF download (dated 22 July 2026) and lets users select tables as PDF or XLS and time series as CSV, up to 2,000 series, packed into a ZIP file, all free. Coverage is Germany. Caveats: the page read does not list the indicators or the licence. For simulation it gives volumes and values of payments by instrument and system in Germany, to size the flows that stop if payment systems, card networks or settlement systems fail. A related catalogue record is the ECB payments statistics.
